summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Clearmind Medicine Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting a press release that announces Johns Hopkins IRB approval to advance its CMND-100 Phase I/II clinical trial to Parts B and C. This is a routine clinical milestone update for a biotech company. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or forced management changes. The filing is purely operational and regulatory, not a special situation.
